_comment: What the wiki was last checked against, and which source files each page's claims come from.
The full maintenance runbook is docs/wiki.md. This file is the machine-readable half of it.
This exists so that 'the wiki needs updating' is an answerable question rather than a re-read
of the whole game. `npm run wiki:check` fetches upstream, diffs these two commits against the
current tips of main and beta, and maps the changed files onto the pages that cite them — so
you get a list of pages to review rather than a list of commits to interpret.
WHEN YOU UPDATE THE WIKI: re-run the check, fix what it flags, then move `verifiedAgainst`
forward to the commits you actually verified against. Leaving it stale is worse than useless,
because the next person will trust it.
`sources` is deliberately coarse. A page lists the files whose behaviour it describes, not
every file it touches — the goal is 'this page probably needs a look', not a build graph.

verifiedAgainst.note: Main absorbed nearly all of beta between 5ee1ab5 and e62a1c5 (the game menu and settings workspace, the Fallback list, Map vNext as the only renderer, the war/relation/agreement/storyline ledgers, sovereignty, Projects & Operations, the engine-driven unit system as the only one, tracked stats, loopback-only networking), so the stable/beta split was rewritten page by page: former beta notes became plain text, and what is beta-only now (puppets and demands, player focus, per-task temperature, structures from events, filed events, the Android app carrying its map) was re-marked. New on both builds and documented: the request budget, Intervene, interactive events, the standing goal, documents, group turns in one request with polls, simulation reminders, the history document, game export/import, scenario features and scenario stat sheets, the 22 shipped language packs. Written from source and from driving the main build's UI in headless Chromium; no campaign was played through turns (no API key in the capture environment).

knownGaps: Map screenshots taken on 2026-09-24 have no basemap imagery: the ArcGIS host was unreachable from the capture environment.
No screenshot of a held time-skip segment or a held Projects board: both live in in-memory pending state and cannot be authored into a save.

No screenshot of Intervene, an interactive event, a group turn with a poll, a document notice, or any beta-only surface (puppet card, demand card, Player focus): each needs AI output or beta, and the 2026-09-24 pass had neither a key nor a beta build running.
Content screenshots (events, diplomacy, advisor, stats, espionage, retry) predate the 2026-09-24 pass and use the older palette.
Neither build was verified by playing a campaign through turns; the 2026-09-24 pass read source and drove main's menus and panels.

pageVerified._comment: Pages re-verified against a commit NEWER than verifiedAgainst. wiki:check skips a page for a channel whose recorded commit here is at or past the current tip. Only add a page you actually re-read. Emptied on 2026-09-11, when the global record moved past every entry that was here.
